newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Telstra closes A$3.0 billion loan facility.
newsitem.headline: Telstra closes A$3.0 billion loan facility.

text.p: Telecommunications group Telstra Corp said on Tuesday that its A$3.0 billion syndicated loan facility had closed oversubscribed.
The facility was arranged by J.P. Morgan Australia Securities Ltd and Credit Suisse First Boston.

Telstra group managing director finance and administration Paul Rizzo said in a statement the offering was well received by all the major domestic banks, and some banks from Europe, North America and one from Japan.
Rizzo said the issue would not be increased despite the over-subscription.
